messages:
alex: Quick sync — MosaicBank POC scoping. Can we lock the prioritized journeys + acceptance criteria by EOD Fri? Customer expects a 3-week pilot. High-level asks: fraud assistant for agent workflow, inbound support triage (phone/email -> routing), and secure doc ingestion (KYC PDFs).

maria: For context — Mosaic wants to prove latency & throughput on their busiest endpoints and show no PII leaks in ingestion. Also asked about pricing if they go Dedicated.

samir: Proposal: prioritize 2 journeys for MVP (fraud assistant + doc ingestion). Triage can be second-phase. Need concrete endpoints and evals so eng can size Dedicated vs hosted.

alex: Agreed. Suggest we define: 1) Fraud assistant: endpoint /v1/fraud-check -> returns risk_score, flags, suggested_action. Success = precision >= 92% on internal eval set, FP rate < 2%, p95 latency < 250ms (hosted baseline) or <200ms on Dedicated. 2) Doc ingestion: endpoint /v1/secure-ingest -> OCR + field extraction + redaction. Success = 99% extraction on fields, zero PII exfil (verified by redaction test), throughput 50 docs/min per GPU.

maria: Customer pricing Q: if they commit to 3-month Dedicated, what discount / burst capacity do we offer? Also they need SOC2 + audit log proof.

samir: Pricing note for AE: Dedicated baseline = reserved pool cost + per-token inference; for 3mo commit we can propose 10% off reserved + 15% off overage tokens. I will confirm exact numbers with finance.

tayla: Security checklist: must confirm KMS integration, VPC peering, HSM option for keys, and stored logs retention policy. Also they want screening of redact rules for SSNs and account numbers. I'll need sample docs to run redaction tests.

alex: Good — add these to success criteria: redaction fail rate = 0 on sampled 500 docs. Also add regression guard rails for hallucination: hallucination rate < 0.5% measured on 1k prompts.

samir: For evals, I'll prepare a small harness. Example curl for fraud inference we plan to run in load test:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/fraud-check \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"user_id":"12345","device":"web","events":[...]}'
```

maria: Nice — customer also pushed back on SSO and entitlements. They require SCIM sync + SAML. Is that on the Private offering only?

tayla: SCIM + SAML supported in Private and Dedicated enterprise console. Hosted can do SAML SSO for the account, but SCIM user sync/entitlement mapping requires Dedicated/Private. Flag that as a potential blocker for self-service trial.

alex: Blockers list summarized so far: 1) SCIM entitlement requirement -> may need Dedicated (ops) 2) Network peering/VPC -> required for doc ingestion with PII 3) KMS/HSM proof -> security sign-off needed 4) Pricing sign-off (3mo discount vs hosted).

samir: Timeline proposal: Week 0 (this week) — finalize use cases + sample data; Week 1 — onboard test account + baseline hosted runs; Week 2 — run targeted evals + latency/cost benchmarks; Week 3 — customer validation + final report. If Dedicated needed, spin-up adds ~5 business days.

maria: Customer asked for example prompts to validate hallucination and accuracy. Samir, can you include a short prompt set for fraud assistant?

samir: Putting a small prompt sample in thread: ```
Prompt A: "Transaction: $4,200 wire to offshore acct, new payee. User reports 'I didn't authorize'. Provide risk_score (0-100) and reasoning with top 3 indicators." 
Prompt B: "Multiple small transactions from same device under different cards. Recommend action and confidence" 
Eval metric: accuracy_of_action, reason_consistency, hallucination_flag (bool)
```

alex: Perfect. Action items: Maria — confirm pricing ask + customer legal timeline. Samir — drop eval harness and initial sample dataset (200 fraud cases, 500 doc scans) by Thurs. Tayla — request sample docs and confirm redaction test plan by Thurs. Ops-bot: schedule Dedicated boot window if needed.

ops-bot: deploy-note: created test org "mosaicbank-poc" and provisional API key expiring in 30 days. Use only on test data.

maria: I'll schedule an alignment call with Mosaic for Thu 10am PT to confirm priorities.

alex: Great. If everyone can confirm owners by EOD, I'll send the formal POC scope doc to Mosaic. :thumbsup:
